Fitted values of a fitted panel copula model

Source: R/copreg-panel.R
fitted.copregpanel.Rd

Two scales are available. With structural = TRUE (the default) these are the fitted values of y = alpha_i + x'beta + z'delta + e on the original rows; with structural = FALSE they are the fitted values of the FOD-transformed model on the transformed rows.

Usage

# S3 method for class 'copregpanel'
fitted(object, structural = TRUE, ...)

Arguments

object

A fitted "copregpanel" object.

structural

Logical; TRUE (the default) for the fitted values of the structural model, FALSE for the fitted values of the FOD-transformed model.

...

Currently unused.

Value

A named numeric vector of fitted values.

Examples

# \donttest{
set.seed(1)
N <- 30L; Time <- 6L
d <- data.frame(id = rep(seq_len(N), each = Time),
                 year = rep(seq_len(Time), times = N))
alpha <- rep(rnorm(N), each = Time)
e <- rnorm(N * Time)
d$x <- exp(rnorm(N * Time) + 0.5 * e)   # endogenous: correlated with e
d$z <- rnorm(N * Time)                  # exogenous
d$y <- alpha + 0.5 * d$x + d$z + e
fit <- CopRegPANEL(y ~ x | z, data = d, index = c("id", "year"),
                    nboots = 15, verbose = FALSE)
fitted(fit)
